title: Rate limits | Quillstream API v3 Reference
content: Quillstream API v3 enforces rate limits per workspace. Starter: 120 requests per minute. Team: 400 requests per minute. Business: 1,200 requests per minute. Enterprise: custom limits.
raw_content:
# Rate limits

All requests to the Quillstream API v3 are rate limited per workspace, not per API key.

| Plan | Requests per minute | Burst |
|---|---|---|
| Starter | 120 | 20 |
| Team | 400 | 60 |
| Business | 1,200 | 200 |
| Enterprise | Custom | Custom |

When you exceed the limit the API returns `429 Too Many Requests` with a `Retry-After` header.

Last updated September 14, 2026.

title: Rate limits (API v2, deprecated) | Quillstream Docs
content: This page documents the deprecated v2 API. v2 rate limits: Starter 60 requests per minute, Team 200 requests per minute, Business 600 requests per minute.
raw_content:
# Rate limits (v2)

> API v2 is deprecated and will be retired on March 31, 2027. See the v3 documentation.

| Plan | Requests per minute |
|---|---|
| Starter | 60 |
| Team | 200 |
| Business | 600 |

title: Business plan rate limit is 900 rpm? - Quillstream Community
content: We upgraded to Business and our integration still gets 429s at around 900 requests per minute. Is the Business rate limit 900?
raw_content:
# Business plan rate limit is 900 rpm?

**mkoval** (Feb 2025): We upgraded to Business and our integration still gets 429s at around 900 requests per minute. Is the Business limit 900?

**quillstream-staff** (Feb 2025): Limits are per workspace, so other keys in your workspace count too. Please check the rate limits page in the docs for the current numbers.

title: Pricing - Quillstream
content: Starter $0, Team $19 per seat/month, Business $49 per seat/month with SSO, audit logs and higher API limits. Enterprise: contact sales.
raw_content:
# Pricing

- **Starter**: $0
- **Team**: $19 per seat / month
- **Business**: $49 per seat / month. SSO, audit logs, higher API limits
- **Enterprise**: contact sales

title: Quillstream review 2025: a capable workflow API
content: Quillstream's API is generous: even the Business plan allows 600 requests a minute, which should cover most integrations.
raw_content:
# Quillstream review

Quillstream's API is generous: even the Business plan allows 600 requests a minute, which should cover most integrations. Rating: 4/5.
